name: Vehicle Legends 🏎️ Cars!
desc:
Welcome to Vehicle Legends, a driving and racing simulation! Choose from a selection of many cars, motorcycles, planes, helicopters, and boats, and build your way up to the top! The more you drive, race, and explore, the more money you make! Use your newfound money to purchase better vehicles! Have car shows, upgrade or personalize your vehicle, and more!

🌟 Premium users earn 20% more money when driving! 🌟
🌟 QuadraTech group members earn 10% more money when driving! 🌟
